name: Missouri River (Breaks)
blurb: White Cliffs and the Wild & Scenic Breaks. Multi-day canoe country out of Fort Benton.

sections.notes: Start at the Chouteau County Fairgrounds canoe launch (river mile 0). This multi-day trip ends at Judith Landing, not James Kipp. Arrange the long shuttle and confirm current launch and take-out access with BLM before departure.

distanceEvidence.sourceName: BLM Upper Missouri trip planning and river access guide

putIn.name: Fort Benton (Canoe Launch)
putIn.sourceLocation: River Access and Launch Sites: Fort Benton Canoe Launch

takeOut.name: Judith Landing
takeOut.sourceLocation: River Access and Launch Sites: Judith Landing

distanceEvidence.note: BLM places the Fort Benton canoe launch at mile 0 and Judith Landing at 88.5. The former 149-mile distance belongs to the longer trip to James Kipp Recreation Area. The motorboat launch is a different start downstream.

notices.title: Confirm seasonal access and shuttle
notices.text: BLM lists Judith Landing campground’s season as May 15–October 15. Check launch access and road conditions separately before arranging an off-season trip; the campground listing does not establish year-round vehicle access to the ramp.

putInAccess.sourceName: BLM Upper Missouri river access guide; Lewistown Area Restrictions Plan 2024–2029
putInAccess.note: The interagency plan lists this named canoe-launch location on printed page 20. It is treated as an approximate facility point. The conflicting canoe-launch UTM easting in the 2017 BLM boater guide was rejected, not silently corrected.
putInAccess.directions: Use the canoe launch at Chouteau County Fairgrounds in Fort Benton (BLM river mile 0). The downstream motorboat launch is a different starting point.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Bureau of Land Management recreation site
takeOutAccess.note: BLM confirms a boat-access facility and publishes this recreation-site coordinate. The exact ramp edge and take-out bank remain unverified; do not substitute the facility marker for the landing.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use Judith Landing Recreation Area on Highway 236. BLM’s boater guide places the boat take-out downstream of the highway bridge; the campground is upstream. Confirm seasonal access before arranging your shuttle.

sections.notes: A remote Missouri Breaks trip with limited road access. Arrange the shuttle before departure; strong winds and weather can change travel time substantially. Check BLM seasonal access, fees and current restrictions.

takeOutAccess.note: BLM explicitly documents a concrete boat ramp and supplies the recreation-site coordinate. The location is approximate; the exact ramp edge and river bank have not been verified.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed Coal Banks Landing campground and contact-station entrance from Virgelle Ferry Road. BLM places the concrete ramp beside the contact station. Confirm road and seasonal facility conditions before arranging the shuttle.
